title: refactor(sim): the field column read from below - march_up, the mirrored sliver law, the shell-crossing read (#637 E2b)
body:
Stacked on #784 (on #782).

Part of #637 (step E2b, design in https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/637#issuecomment-6787218007 sections 2-3). Fork synced at v0.17.0.

## What changed

- **`march_up` (new `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/march_up.rs`)** - the mirror of `march`/`refine`: the same keyed probe and budgets, rising from the world floor, descending from the first material probe to the LOWEST material centre, and reading the floor from the `cut_downs` record there (a flipped bake's `cut_ups` records moved whole) or the shell's lowest crossing in the bracket, the higher binding.
- **`column_span` reads both sides.** The top is `march`'s; the floor is `march_up`'s whenever the field holds any `cut_downs`. A field with none keeps E1's monotone law (a material centre proves the shell floor) with no ascent, so the upright path is byte-identical in value and cost.
- **The shell-crossing read (both marches).** `refine` read an uncut surface at the cell boundary where the stored sign flipped - exact only for a lattice-aligned plane. Both `refine`s now read the cached parity column's crossing inside the bracket (`march::shell_in`), exact to rounding for any plane; where a cut entry and a crossing both bind, the one nearer the material centre wins (`march::face`, the column engine's own `min(top, cut)`). On aligned fixtures the crossing IS the boundary, so the parity and verdict suites read the same floats.
- **Neither a crossing nor a record is `Unreadable`.** On an upright field it cannot happen (every proven-inside cell records entry 0, and the cell under it a finite entry); it does for a flipped bounded tool's bottom face, which the old code would have guessed at the boundary. Refused by name instead.
- **The sliver law is one scan.** With no material centre the material lies between two adjacent air centres: the lower centre's `cut_ups` entry is the upper cut's bottom, the upper centre's `cut_downs` entry is the lower cut's top, the shell binds where no record does, a centre proven inside a cut is that cut's whole half-line. It reads E1's floor sliver, its mirror under a flipped cut, and a sliver floating between a cut from below and one from above. An air centre strictly inside the shell proves a cut, so a missing record there is refused, as E1 refused.
- **E2a's interim refusal lifted.** `turned` no longer sets `bounded_cuts` on a flipped bake; the flag follows the tool alone. Commit 1 pins the interim `CutFromBelow` on a flipped bake (the #784 review note); commit 2 replaces that pin with the exact read.
- **A level facet's crossing is exactly its height** (`solid_rest::plane_claim`, commit 3). The heavy lane caught the crossing read's one caveat: the barycentric sum rounds by an ulp on some rays even when the facet's three z are equal (the stepped facing golden's uncut columns at y = -6.25 read 2.0 + 1 ulp over a 2.0 stock top, and the rest ladder's strict `above(2.0)` mask disagreed where the old boundary read was exact by accident). A facet whose three z are equal now answers that z; a tilted facet keeps the sum. E1's floor on those columns reads -638.0 instead of -638.0000000000001 too. Pinned by `solid_rest::tests::a_level_facet_crosses_at_exactly_its_height` (three boxes, 441 rays each, bit for bit).
- `down_at` moves from a `cfg(test)` helper in `field_turn` to `field_ray` beside `up_at`. `floor_at` keeps its API. No column-engine verdict, golden or snapshot changes.

Decisions: `docs/decisions/780-field-march-up.md`.

## How tested

Pinning tests (all in `crates/sim/tests/`):

- `field_floor`: `a_flipped_bake_reads_a_cut_floor_exactly_from_cut_downs` (the exact read where the interim refusal was pinned, plus the upright bake unchanged), `a_flipped_slot_through_the_plate_reads_empty_and_its_neighbours_exact`, `a_flipped_sliver_under_the_top_is_read_from_the_record_above_it` (0.2 sliver, the zero-height column, a hair past it empty), `a_flipped_bounded_tool_refuses_by_name` (`Unreadable` for the taper's unrecorded bottom face, `CutFromBelow` where its cut came near the new floor), `an_unaligned_plane_reads_its_shell_crossing_on_both_sides` (top 0.1 / floor -6.3 on a 0.5 cell, uncut and flipped with a slot).
- `carry_engine_agreement`: `a_baked_turn_reads_what_the_view_reads_through_every_turn` now compares the whole `column_body` read-back bit-for-bit through all 8 turns, flips included (the skip is gone); `an_unaligned_block_top_carries_the_same_on_both_engines` (top 5.1: slot, sliver, through); the cut-after-flip fixture (`cut_after_flip_agrees`: block, slot from the top, flipped through the bake with the translation applied to the moves by hand, slot from the new top across it, every column's top, floor, `empty_at` and the volume equal to the column body's to 1e-6): `a_slot_cut_after_the_flip_carries_the_same_on_both_engines` (3.0 / 4.0), `a_sliver_between_a_cut_from_below_and_one_from_above_carries_the_same` (3.0 / 2.2 and 2.7 / 2.6 - a sliver floating between the two cuts), `a_second_slot_through_the_first_carries_the_same_on_both_engines` (3.0 / 1.5 and -1.0 / 2.5).
- `field_turn` unit test: a flipped bake no longer sets `bounded_cuts`.
- Review fixes: `field_floor::a_stock_plane_on_a_cell_centre_reads_exactly_on_both_sides` and `field_floor::no_column_under_reports_across_plates_and_slots_on_and_off_the_lattice` (round 1: the centre walk, 432 `column_span` reads, every one exact); `field_skin::a_floor_skin_under_a_slot_is_a_verdict_on_every_path` and `field_skin::no_column_the_shell_proves_reads_nan_or_air_through_stock_top` (round 2: a centre-less floor skin reads through `Stock::top`, `deviate` and the column masks - 1296 reads, every one exact, none NaN).

Agreement results: every column agrees to 1e-6 (tops, floors, `empty_at`, volume) through all 8 turns for the slot, deep slot, through-slot, floor sliver and unaligned-top fixtures; the off-grid ball slot within its 1e-3 march tolerance as before; the baked read-back is bit-identical to the view's for all 8 turns.

Locally (macOS, debug): `cargo test -p camcraft-sim` lib (68) and `field_floor`, `field_body`, `field_carry`, `carry_engine_agreement`, `stock_sdf`, `stock_sdf_cut`, `stock_backend_parity`, `field_arc_sweep`, `stock_field_cost`, `field_block_cost`, `stock_carry`, `stock_sim` - all green; `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean; `hidden_rest_banded`, `ridge_rest` green; the touched sim suites' `--ignored` lanes in release green. `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/issue/779-field-turn-bake`: sim suites (27 binaries + lib), motion `posed_subtract`, app `stock_export` + `verify` - 0 failed (1.2 min wall, run twice: before and after commit 3). App's heavy lane `stock_engine_agreement` (release, `--ignored`): 3 passed - `both_engines_judge_every_golden_program_alike` over every golden program, the feed sampler and the Pocket3D consumers agree (this lane is what caught the level-facet ulp; it is green with the fix).

Linux batch gate: 0 failed - every tier step (geometry, cl, tools, post, sim, motion with its slow lanes, app with center_cut_multiaxis, ui, clippy -D warnings), 15.1 min wall.

## Not exercised

- `CarriedField::simulate` through the residual translation (E2c, #781) - the cut-after-flip fixture applies the translation to the moves by hand. The app holders (#586) and the default flip (#589) are untouched.
- Multi-crossing (undercut) meshes: the floor under a cut from below is the lowest material centre's cell crossing (the hull law), as the top has always been the highest's; no fixture has sub-cell slabs on both sides.
- Quarter turns with flips are covered by the 8-turn suite only on the block fixtures.

Changelog: none (internal: the field engine is not the default; no shipped verdict changes)
Effort: max (no escalation)

Fixes #780
Fixes #824
